states: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description:
A dedicated and student-centric Education Counsellor with extensive experience guiding learners across India on critical academic and career decisions, including Study Abroad opportunities, choosing the right streams/subjects, and exploring unconventional academic paths that align with future-ready careers. Having completed an MBA from IIM Ahmedabad, this counsellor combines top-tier management education with ground-level counselling expertise to deliver practical, structured, and outcome-focused guidance.

Skilled in helping students and parents navigate complex choices after 10th, 12th, and graduation, the counsellor offers personalised mentoring on subject combinations, course selection, and country/program fit for overseas education. With a strong understanding of evolving global and Indian education trends, they specialise in presenting clear comparisons, demystifying new-age and offbeat careers, and building realistic roadmaps tailored to each student’s aptitude, budget, and long-term goals.

Known for a calm, approachable style and transparent advice, this counsellor works pan-India and supports students through every step—from clarity on interests and psychometric insights to shortlisting courses, colleges, and unconventional options such as liberal arts, design, communication, and emerging tech-linked programs. The focus is always on helping students make informed, confident decisions that balance passion, practicality, and long-term career growth.
